versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "building-journalist-outreach-list-from-twitter"
- Finds and filters journalists, editors, and media contacts on Twitter/X for specific beats or topics using Apify actors
- Returns key info: name, handle, publication affiliation, follower count, recent coverage topics
- Supports detailed input parameters and filtering for public relations and press list building
- Output formats include formatted lists with beat/publication grouping and personalization notes for effective pitching
